scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of all-n moments and equality cases; standalone exact rational tests are supplementary, not exhaustive proof. No independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact unweighted combinatorial path Laplacian pseudoinverse, independent symmetric signs only; no general-graph or Krylov-truncation result; historical rearrangement equivalences and publication priority not fully excluded. The weak Brownian bridge limit is classical.
title: Sharp finite risk and extremal sign patterns for path-Laplacian trace probes
